title: Open inverse image preserves injective abelian sheaves
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes and $j:Y\to X$ an open immersion [def-sc-zariski-site]. On abelian sheaves on their Zariski sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $j^{-1}$ be the inverse-image functor of [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. Then $j^{-1}$ sends every injective abelian sheaf [def-sp-injective-resolutions] on $X$ to an injective abelian sheaf on $Y$.

source.place: Stacks Tags 03DI (extension-by-zero adjunction), 03DJ (exactness), and 04J0 (localization of morphisms of ringed sites); represented free-sheaf restriction and inverse image in the open-subscheme Zariski case.

proof.text: Use Mathlib Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.sheafPullbackIso to identify inverse image with sectionwise restriction along the open-image functor. Identify Y with the open subscheme j.opensRange by IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq. Restriction to that open followed by the induced sheaf equivalence is the sectionwise restriction along j.

Apply clause (2) of lem-weil-pbc-zariski-open-restriction-injectives on X and its open j.opensRange, then transport injectivity along the equivalence of sheaf categories and the preceding functor isomorphism. The proof of that clause is exact extension by zero left adjoint to restriction; equivalences preserve injectivity. Empty and top images require no extra assumption.

proof_origin.place: Proof of lem-pc-open-restriction-ext-bijective, exact open restriction and represented free sheaves; instantiated to the Lean inverse-image presentation.
